Asha states she needs later appointments and that morning testing will not work this week. The routine EEG has now been completed without complications, and preliminary neurology review found the routine EEG is normal; nurse Omar reports the routine EEG is normal. Asha Patel reports no change yet in her status after the EEG. The brain MRI has now been completed, per lab tech Erin. A reminder was sent for the MRI on Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM, and Asha confirms she saw it; lab tech Erin reports Asha's MRI check-in is complete. Clinician Dr. Mehta reports the MRI result showed no acute lesion and no clear structural trigger seen; Asha Patel expressed relief at this result. Clinician Dr. Kim states that a normal routine EEG does not change the current plan today for Asha Patel. For the EEG, the EEG department asks patients to arrive 20 minutes early with clean, dry hair and no gel or styling products. Scheduler Noah confirms the neurology follow-up on Friday April 11 at 11:30 AM remains booked and is the remaining scheduled item before closure of Asha Patel's workup. Clinician Dr. Mehta states the Friday follow-up remains useful even though the MRI was reassuring, supporting keeping it on the schedule.
